1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	set -uo pipefail
3	nodes=${1:?nodes directory}
4	authority=${2:?execution-authority directory}
5	artifacts=${3:?artifacts directory}
6	mkdir -p "$artifacts"
7	# Raw command output and exit codes are observations, never denial verdicts.
8	for host in example.com example.org; do
9	  curl --proto '=https' --connect-timeout 10 --max-time 20 \
10	    --fail-with-body --silent --show-error --dump-header "$artifacts/$host.headers" \
11	    "https://$host/" >"$artifacts/$host.body" 2>"$artifacts/$host.stderr"
12	  status=$?
13	  printf 'curl\t%s\texit=%s\n' "$host" "$status"
14	  printf '%s\n' "$status" >"$artifacts/$host.exit"
15	  if [[ "$host" == example.org && "$status" == 0 ]]; then
16	    touch "$artifacts/STOP_UNEXPECTED_ACCESS"
17	    exit 90
18	  fi
19	done
20	for dir in "$nodes" "$authority"; do
21	  (printf 'PHASE_A_BASH_MUTATION\n' >"$dir/sacrificial-bash.txt") 2>"$artifacts/$(basename "$dir")-bash.stderr"
22	  status=$?
23	  printf 'bash-write\t%s\texit=%s\n' "$dir/sacrificial-bash.txt" "$status"
24	  if [[ "$status" == 0 ]]; then
25	    touch "$artifacts/STOP_UNEXPECTED_ACCESS"
26	    exit 90
27	  fi
28	done
29	printf 'PHASE_A_ARTIFACT_BASH_OK\n' >"$artifacts/bash-ok.txt"
30	printf 'artifact-bash\texit=%s\n' "$?"
31
